subject: general
question: Shopkeeper A, gives two successive discounts of 8% and 12% on the marked price of Rs.500. Another shopkeeper B allows a single discount of 20% on an article of the same marked price. Find the difference in their selling prices.
solution:
Given:

Shopkeeper A, gives two successive discounts of 8% and 12% on the marked price of Rs. Rs 500.

Another shopkeeper B allows a single discount of 20% on an article of the same marked price.

Concept used:

Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

Final discount given by Shopkeeper A = 8 + 12 - (12 × 8)/100 = 19.04%

Now, the the difference in their selling prices = 500 × (20 - 19.04)%

⇒ 500 × 0.96%

⇒ Rs. 4.80

∴ The difference in their selling prices is Rs. 4.80.
